verdicts.reason: A loses the order entirely: the CTA is jammed into the top-right corner against the edge, with the tiny logo crowding it. 'Ships late June' floats top-left, away from its button, and the 'Limited Summer Release' eyebrow has dropped to the bottom, below its own headline. The legal block is as large as the body copy and competes with the headline. B keeps a sensible eyebrow → headline → body → CTA flow, with the CTA properly placed bottom-left. But B also drops the dark brand header, which leaves the white SOLSTICE wordmark nearly invisible on cream. Its legal copy is still oversized and takes over the whole right column, the eyebrow sits apart in the top-right, and the headline is cramped at a small size.
